summary.text: Torrey Harris is a Democratic state representative from Tennessee House District 91 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Torrey Harris's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes work as a human resources director, a public relations consultant, an investor, and chief officer of corporate, foundation, and major gifts for LeMoyne-Owen College.
Ballotpedia says he has been affiliated with the National Black Caucus of State Legislators and the Tennessee Black Caucus of State Legislators.
He assumed office in Tennessee House District 91 on November 8, 2022.
For the 2023-2024 session Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Civil Justice and Transportation committees.
